gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-bai-jamjuree: Wide-open horseshoe curves, loud and unmistakable. Cherry Swash grabs attention with heavy diagonals and a strong personality, while Bai Jamjuree quietly does the opposite, with light, round, friendly letters and no stroke modulation at all.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tenor-sans: Horseshoe curves and sturdy diagonals, all swagger. Cherry Swash can take a generous size, while Tenor Sans, a plain sans with stems slightly heavier than its hairlines, looks best a notch smaller and gives the page a contemporary hush.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-albert-sans: Ruler-straight strokes with gaping e shapes, plainly playful. Happy Monkey brings the boldness, and Albert Sans, a plain sans with apertures that hold open even tiny, delivers the strongest quality here: a loud heading and a body that stays legible.
